name: Infrared Obstacle Proximity Sensor
description: Like a blind person's cane! Bounces short-range infrared light off nearby obstacles to avoid collisions.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a blind person's cane! Bounces short-range infrared light off nearby obstacles to avoid collisions.
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, and OUT (Green) to digital pin 4.
commonMistakes: Turning the sensitivity potentiometer too far until the sensor is stuck LOW.
Expecting reliable detection on dark black surfaces.

miniExperiment.title: Proximity Trap
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, OUT to Pin 4.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Serial Monitor prints obstacle warnings whenever an object approaches within 2-10cm.
